Overview

Mixed residential towers above retail need coordinated loading zones—management often assigns fixed hours.

Access, traffic, and staging

  • Reserve service elevator separate from retail delivery docks if shared.
  • Weekday mid-morning slots reduce conflict with café deliveries.
  • Ground-floor shops need clear path from truck to stockroom.

What to tell your surveyor

  • Exact woreda address and gate name for truck authorization.
  • Floor level, elevator size, and whether freight lift hours are limited.
  • Items needing disassembly (imported kitchens, L-shaped sofas, king beds).

Neighborhood note

Combine mid-week scheduling with written condo permits to avoid end-of-month elevator conflicts.

More FAQs

How far in advance should I book? For condos in Bole, Ayat, or Kazanchis, book 1–2 weeks ahead; inter-city and large office moves need 2–4 weeks.

Do you provide packing materials? Yes—see packaging materials guide and packaging service.

Before moving day

  • Confirm management move rules, freight lift booking, and security ID lists for truck plate and crew.
  • Declutter to reduce volume; label rooms and mark FRAGILE on electronics and glass.
  • Photograph meters and wall condition at origin; repeat at destination before furniture covers walls.
  • Check holiday traffic and end-of-month rush when picking dates.
